newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka again passes sugar tender, to retender.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka again passes sugar tender, to retender.

text.p: Sri Lanka again passed on a tender for 12,500 tonnes of white refined sugar on Friday but planned to call for fresh bids early next week, government officials said.
"A decision was made not to purchase on this tender," an official for the state buying arm, the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment, said.
"We will be refloating the tender early next week," he said.
The official said most of the suppliers had increased their prices.
The CWE first passed on the tender on Thursday and asked participants to rebid on Friday.

On Thursday, the London market was unclear whether Sri Lanka had in fact bought at its tender, with some traders saying the country had paid $343.00 a tonne c&f for 12,500 tonnes of lesser quality white sugar.
